paper_title: Search for hidden-photon cold dark matter using a K-band cryogenic receiver
notes: Dish-antenna (planar plate + cryogenic K-band receiver) haloscope search for hidden-photon CDM at 27.998-28.012 GHz (mass 115.79-115.85 ueV). No signal found; 95% CL upper limits chi < 1.8-4.3e-10 across the band. Exact per-bin limits only shown in Figure 7; emitted a conservative flat envelope at the worst-case value 4.3e-10 over the stated mass range (best limit in band is 1.8e-10). Assumed local DM density 0.39 GeV/cm^3 (Catena & Ullio). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 2))
